Based on my search, I can provide you with detailed information about the G-Wagon.

The **G-Wagon** (also known as the **G-Wagen** or officially as the **Mercedes-Benz G-Class**) is a **luxury SUV** with distinctive characteristics:

## Vehicle Type Classification

The G-Wagon is primarily classified as a **luxury SUV** (Sport Utility Vehicle) that combines:
- **Off-road capability** - Originally developed as a military 4×4 off-road vehicle
- **Luxury features** - High-end interior with premium materials and advanced technology
- **Body-on-frame construction** - Traditional truck-like construction rather than unibody design

## Key Characteristics

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Full Name** | Mercedes-Benz G-Class (Geländewagen) |
| **Meaning** | "Geländewagen" = German for "off-road vehicle" or "terrain vehicle" |
| **Drive System** | 4MATIC all-wheel drive with three fully locking differentials |
| **Body Style** | Iconic boxy, angular design with flat surfaces and round headlamps |
| **Seating** | Typically 5 passengers |
| **Construction** | Body-on-frame (ladder frame chassis) |

## Origins and Evolution

The G-Wagon was **originally developed in the 1970s as a military vehicle** commissioned by the Shah of Iran. It was first produced in 1979 by Magna Steyr in Austria. Over the decades, it transitioned from a utilitarian military and utility vehicle to a **luxury status symbol** while retaining its rugged off-road capabilities and distinctive boxy appearance.

## Current Variants

Today, the G-Class lineup includes:
- **G 500 / G 550** - Base luxury model with V8 engine
- **AMG G 63** - High-performance version (577 hp)
- **G 350 d / G 400 d** - Diesel variants (popular outside the U.S.)
- **Maybach G 650 Landaulet** - Ultra-luxury limited edition
- **EQG** - Upcoming all-electric version

The G-Wagon is unique in that it maintains its classic, largely unchanged exterior design for over 40 years while continuously upgrading its interior luxury and technology, making it one of the most recognizable and iconic vehicles in the world.
